scope: Open questions about the Wolfe Classics 935 cylinder-head scan, consolidated from the documents listed under each item. This register answers nothing by measurement: the owner constraint is no physical measurement and no part purchase.

status_values.answered: settled by a cited project input
status_values.blocked: cannot be settled from local data; the named owner holds the next step

items.question: What length unit do the OBJ coordinates use?
items.answer: 1 OBJ unit = 1 mm, explicitly confirmed by the owner and recorded as the accepted project input for OBJ SHA-256 4623d5d3b73fe3d03ca988a47543a8dd1be7834d3040e6f7efd1e1e95c766486.

scale_check_before_cfd.conversion: identity (factor 1.0); the provisional interface values in twins/reference-935-cylinder-head/README.md are therefore in mm
scale_check_before_cfd.plausibility_check: At factor 1.0 the fitted chamber shoulder (90.81) and outer register (113.53) bracket the 930/78-930/79 customer-document bores of 95 and 97 mm (docs/research/m64-dimensions-deep-20261024/README.md). Factors of 10 or 25.4 would give 9.1 mm or 2306 mm shoulders, which are not cylinder-head features. This rules out a gross unit error only.
scale_check_before_cfd.limits: Not a metrological scale validation: no physical reference dimension of the specimen exists in the repository, and fit residuals are not a full uncertainty. CFD stays blocked by Q4 and by the incomplete fluid regions (docs/research/935-scan-engineering-20261029.md, Remaining evidence gates), not by the unit.

items.question: Where is the fourth stud/through passage, and what are its axis and diameter?
items.answer: Three passage candidates are retained at two section stations; the fourth is not resolved in the scan and is deliberately not completed by symmetry.
sources: twins/reference-935-cylinder-head/README.md (Provisional interfaces: four-passage pattern about 86.74 x 85.92, fitted on the visible mesh)
items.unblock_requires: Existing drawings, CT or measurements of the specimen from the supplier, or a rescan covering the occluded passage.
items.owner: repository owner (specimen-data request to the supplier, prepared and unsent per docs/research/935-readiness-20261104/README.md)

items.question: What anatomical features do the two extracted external shank axes belong to?
items.answer: Two external shank-axis candidates are retained; their anatomy is unresolved.
items.unblock_requires: Supplier drawing or annotated photographs identifying the features.

items.question: Which specimen was scanned, what is its head-body alloy, and how was it made and machined?
items.answer: The private correspondence supports a cast/machined origin but supplies no alloy, interface, internal-geometry or process data. Valve and seat materials in the supplier screenshot do not identify the head-body alloy. No alloy, machine or supplier is accepted.
items.unblock_requires: Answer to the pending question about specimen access or existing drawings/CT/measurements; process data from Falcontech/Farsoon (requests unsent).
items.owner: repository owner (send or approve the prepared requests)

items.question: Is the 993 bore of 100 mm verified?
items.answer: Not page-checked. catalog/manual/993-workshop-manual-measurements.json gives 'Bore 100 (3.94)' from PDF p.15 with extraction_status structured_derived and a garbled unit 'mnrvin.'. It is consistent with stroke 76.4 mm and 3.6 L (pi/4 x 10.0^2 x 7.64 x 6 = 3600.6 cm3), which is a consistency check, not a page check. Either way it is a different feature from the 113.53 register and the 90.81 shoulder, so no compatibility follows.
items.unblock_requires: A page check of PDF p.15 by someone holding the manual, recorded under catalog/manual/page-checked/.

items.question: What is the 993 head-stud pattern and stud geometry to compare with the 935 passages?
items.answer: No local source gives the 993 cylinder/head stud pattern. The only page-checked stud entry is the exhaust-side M8 x 22 stud protrusion (PDF p.148), which is not the head-to-case stud pattern.
items.unblock_requires: A cited drawing or manual page with the 993 stud pitch circle/pattern and stud diameter.
